assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (floor area ratio, building height, density, green ratio target, setback lines), road redlines, land ownership, municipal utility conditions, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only against the provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls in `用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案` and `总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计` still need professional confirmation before any strength-of-development conclusion can be drawn.

assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and the three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional (`official_boundary=false`), derived from the coordinate ranges published in the announcement, not from an official redline file.
assumptions.impact: All area figures, ratios, and spatial adjacency claims in `proposal.md` and `metrics.json` must be recomputed once official geometry is released; the package explicitly does not treat provisional geometry as an approval basis.

assumptions.statement: The two wings (Exchange Wing / 通证翼 along Zhongguancun Dajie–Xueyuan Lu, and Practice Wing / 践证翼 along the Xiaoyuehe watercourse) have no official geometry in the site package. Their geometry is agent-authored (`AI_SERVICE_ZONE`, `editable_by_agent=true`), anchored to OSM current-condition road network and waterway data.
assumptions.impact: 两翼几何为方案自造的机制载体建议，非官方边界；水系仅引用 OSM 现状 `waterway`，不新造蓝线；具体走向与岸线可达性须 P4 阶段以 Overpass 实测复核后落图。

assumptions.statement: Seven data points used in the global benchmark and regional-synergy narrative are secondhand or unverified-provenance figures: Station F cumulative funding/jobs/survival rate (third-party aggregation); Kendall Square lab space area (unit disputed, not cited as a number); one-north startup count and workforce (real-estate blog reference); Haidian AI enterprise structure ratio ~70/15/5% (public industry observation, no primary source); heritage park phase-2 length/area/served population (media reports); Zhongguancun AI North Latitude Community figures (public reports from the 2025 forum announcement); Beiying (former Beijing Film Studio) six facts (cross-referenced public government/media sources).
assumptions.impact: 以上七项均已在正文加「据公开报道/据公开产业观察/据第三方汇编估算」限定语，且明确禁止进入 `metrics.json`；仅作叙事佐证，不作为量化指标使用。

assumptions.statement: Municipal utility capacity and compute-power (grid load, cooling, network backbone) supporting the proposed public compute pool and edge-compute nodes has not been verified against official municipal engineering data (`GAP-MUNICIPAL-001`).
assumptions.impact: 本方案不给出任何具体算力规模数字，不作能源负荷或市政容量结论；`交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施` 节的算力要素表述均为概念建议，须专业市政工程团队核验后方可深化为具体配置方案。

assumptions.statement: The precise heritage-protection boundary and construction-control zone for Qinghuayuan Station and the Dazhongsi national-level heritage site are not present in the public site package; `HERITAGE_PROTECTION` is treated as a non-editable, reference-only layer.
assumptions.impact: 本方案对两处文保对象只做外部公共空间的提示性引导，不给出任何涉及文保本体的改造结论；精确保护范围待官方或文物主管部门数据发布后由专业团队核实。

assumptions.statement: The proposed name root "Proving" (京张实证带 / The Jingzhang Proving Belt) is conceptually adjacent to a competing submission's "proofline" root, though the two terms carry different semantics (proof = a settled result; proving = an ongoing, revocable test).
assumptions.impact: 若独立审核判定命名过近，方案已备妥候选二「京张验城带 / The Jingzhang Verified City Belt」，切换成本约 20 处（含 tagline 三条、国际传播文案一段、母品牌名及其四级派生词）。

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory control conditions (floor area ratio, building height, density, green ratio target, setback lines, GAP-CONTROL-001) for the three key areas are not present in the public site package and have not been confirmed against official 控规 (regulatory detailed plan) attachments.
assumptions.impact: 本方案在 `用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案` 与 `总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计` 两节中，凡涉及容积率/高度/密度/绿地率/退线的表述均标注 `GAP-CONTROL-001` 且不作强度类结论，`metrics.json` 中相关指标标注为 unknown 或 pending_control；待官方控规条件发布后由专业团队核实。

assumptions.statement: The three key areas involve at least four categories of tenure/usage-right holders (university research land, military/classified-use land, existing residents' co-owned property portions, municipal and collective land, GAP-TENURE-001); coordination pathways, boundaries, and inter-party responsibilities among these holders have not been defined.
assumptions.impact: 本方案在「总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计」节新增「实施前提与产权协调路径」一段，将产权协调复杂度列为正式深化阶段的首要前置条件，不提供可直接套用的产权处置方案；居民共有部分涉及《民法典》第二百七十八条业主共同决定事项的，须履行相应表决程序。
